info.description: Narrow OID4VCI 1.0 Final delivery profile, plus an optional, separately identified OID4VCI Draft 13 compatibility profile under /protocol/oid4vci/draft-13 that exists only when the deployment configures draft13Profile. The normative source is products/evidence/contracts/oid4vci-profile.yaml. This contract does not claim full issuer certification or conformance.
